## Overview

Learn how to extract DNA from cells using simple household materials Read through the material below and then watch the presentation.

[→ View the slides](slides.qmd)

## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Extraction solution** — A mixture of salt, water, and detergent that breaks down cell and nuclear membranes
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Precipitation** — When DNA comes out of solution and becomes visible
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Detergent** — A substance that dissolves lipids, breaking down the fatty membranes around cells
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Salting out** — Using salt to make DNA clump together and separate from water
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Sample preparation** — Breaking down tissue or cells into smaller pieces
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Filtration** — Removing solid debris from the liquid solution
:::
